answer: Each identity gets a throughput cap of 0.5 of the pool per epoch until it has survived 10 epochs, which stops a sudden burst of forge accounts from outproducing veterans. The cap is not raisable by spawning, so an attacker's pigment-ledger capacity per identity is fixed and linear. The engine re-reads the cap table at each close and enforces it during the ferrous-grade-pass settlement.
